project.title: Demo · AI Customer Service in Feishu
project.tagline: Auto-reply common 30% questions on night shifts, with order and FAQ integrations.

return-policy.title: Return within 7 days
return-policy.body:
You can return the item within 7 days of delivery, as long as it is unopened.
Reply RETURN-12345 to start a return.

transfer.title: Transferring to a human
transfer.body: Connecting you to a human agent now. Average wait time: 30s.

boundaries.text: In scope: Feishu single chat, FAQ retrieval, order lookup, transfer to human.
Single-tenant deployment, daily data purge after 7 days.
Out of scope: WeChat, group chat, multi-language beyond EN/ZH, outbound calls.
No real backend yet — this demo is fully driven by mock-data.json.
